description: This file defines the abstract base class AbstractRealDistribution for real-valued probability distributions in the Apache Commons Math library. It provides default implementations for certain distribution methods and manages random sampling mechanics.

classes.name: AbstractRealDistribution
classes.description: Abstract base class for probability distributions on the real line, providing common functionality such as sampling, cumulative probability calculations, and inverse cumulative probability computations.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability(double, double)
methods.description: Deprecated method that computes P(x0 < X ≤ x1) using the default probability(double x0, double x1) method.

methods.name: probability(double x)
methods.description: Returns the probability density at point x; default implementation returns 0.

methods.name: inverseCumulativeProbability(double p)
methods.description: Computes the inverse of the cumulative distribution function via numerical methods, with bracketing and search algorithms.

methods.name: sample()
methods.description: Generates a random sample from the distribution using inverse transform sampling.

methods.name: sample(int sampleSize)
methods.description: Generates an array of samples by repeatedly calling sample().
